leg_actuators.reference_product_revision: V1.1; actual hardware revision not confirmed
leg_actuators.notes: Manufacturer output-side ratings already include the internal gearbox. Do not apply its ratio again to the confirmed 1:1 output-to-joint transmission. Ratings are reference data, not a measured 19-24 V torque-speed envelope.
leg_actuators.low_voltage_status: 19 V is below the current V1.1 published 24-48 V range; no 19 V performance or undervoltage operation is assumed.

wheel_actuators.ratio_scope: Total rotor-to-wheel ratio, replacing the original total reduction; not an additional stage.
wheel_actuators.notes: 10 A is a DC-input reference at the original 24 V rated operating point; it is not directly programmed as a C620 phase-current ceiling. Gearbox efficiency and the current/thermal envelope of the modified drive are unmeasured.
wheel_actuators.current_policy: Use manual rated current; no extra peak-current profile requested.
wheel_actuators.current_measurement_location: ESC DC power input; not CAN commanded motor/phase current.

estimated_output_at_24V.assumptions: Same motor and C620 behaviour; unchanged gearbox efficiency. Ratio-only estimates, not measured modified-wheel ratings.

remaining_calibration: Validate actual torque-speed/current/thermal envelope, especially legs below 24 V and wheels at 22 V.
Confirm a hardware current-control interpretation before configuring C620 CAN current limits.
Validate inherited PD gains and action ranges in a single-robot dynamics test.
runtime_profile_status: Provisional 24 V continuous-output reference, not validated across actual voltage ranges.
